title: Event-Driven Systems
definition: In advanced architectures, Express APIs often act as producers in an Event-Driven architecture. Instead of waiting for a long database process to finish, Express accepts the request, publishes an event to a Message Broker (like RabbitMQ or Kafka), and immediately returns a 202 Accepted response.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Event-Driven Systems?
